acceptance_criteria.statement: calibration_table pairs both verdicts for a head and reports missed and false-block titles.
A bee blocking finding the human did not raise appears as a false block and not as a miss.
Nine paired reviews are not enough to promote.
Ten reviews including three gate_security/deploy_path reviews with no misses promote.
One missed blocking finding blocks promotion even at ten reviews.
A false-block rate of exactly 20% promotes and anything above 20% does not.

observable_behavior: missed findings are human findings absent from the bee's
false blocks are bee findings absent from the human's
promotion needs 10 PRs, 3 sensitive reviews, zero misses and <= 20% false blocks
outcome.summary: Record the bee and human/outside verdicts for the same head, compute the calibration table (missed findings, false blocks) and the promotion status: at least 10 PRs including 3 gate_security or deploy_path reviews, zero missed blocking findings, false-block rate <= 20%.
